rows.whyBlockedSourceDespiteEverySourceBeingH: The stop is not a missing binary. All four declared digests resolve under the master library and were re-hashed from bytes by this lane. The stop is that the four held binaries are editions of DIFFERENT New Hampshire courts and cannot name one filing court between them.
rows.why: A packet is filed in one court. NHJB-3057-DSe, the petition, names its court through the drop-down court.district/su, whose 43 options are 11 Superior Courts and 31 Circuit Court District Divisions, so this route files in one of those two tiers. NHJB-2311-Se names its court through court.superior, whose 12 options are a blank and 11 Superior Courts and no Circuit Court division at all. NHJB-2328-DFPe names its court through court.district/family/probate - both, whose 74 options are District, Family and Probate divisions and include no Superior Court at all. In a Superior Court annulment the financial statement cannot name the court; in a District Division annulment the fee-waiver motion cannot. Neither form carries a free-text court field, so neither gap can be filled with text. The suffixes agree with the drop-downs: -Se is the Superior court edition, -DFPe the District, Family and Probate edition, -DSe the District edition of the petition. Filling the Superior motion for a Circuit Court annulment would deliver the wrong court's motion, and leaving its court blank would deliver a motion that does not say where it is filed. Neither is a defect a build can absorb.
rows.measuredByThisLaneIndependentlyOfTheBuil: Every drop-down and every field of all four binaries was enumerated directly from the master-library bytes with pdf-lib, not read back from the build script's own summary. The court-list measurement reproduced exactly.

additionalDefectThisLaneFoundAndTheScrip.finding: Its 43 options are Family Division and Probate Division entries exclusively. It reaches NEITHER tier this route files in, so unlike the two fee-waiver components - each of which can at least name a court in one tier - this component cannot name the filing court in any case this route can produce. It is blocked in every tier.

rows.purposeOfRecordLineIsAnOwnerDeterminatio: NHJB-2956 prints PURPOSE OF RECORD: Housing / Employment / Annulment/Expungement / Other ______. The route's identity answers it, but the binary draws no control beside the printed options - no AcroForm widget, no stroked box - so marking it would put ink at a hand-entered coordinate in white space, and writing the purpose into the Other rule would state that the purpose is Other, which is false. Not the stop; recorded for the owner.

or binding the Superior Court financial statement that matches NHJB-2311-Se and scoping this family to Superior Court annulments
and in either case binding a criminal-history release whose court chooser reaches the tier the packet is filed in, because NHJB-2956-FPe reaches neither
or an owner determination that the fee-waiver and criminal-history components may be dropped and replaced by a pointer to whichever forms the filing court actually uses

sourceDigestsVerifiedFromBytes.note: held in the Nationwide recovery pool custody, which is mounted in the main clone and not at this sparse worktree repoRoot. Resolved by content hash against that root and re-hashed from the bytes; not resolved by path and not substituted.

rows.why: Not one of the five carries a fillable control. Each has no /AcroForm in its catalog, no /XFA and zero annotations on every page, measured from the bytes; the committed corpus index agrees, recording all five as structuralClassObserved flat_pdf with acroFieldCount 0. That alone is not a stop, because the factory has a sanctioned flat path. The stop is what that path can reach. Applied to 1003EX, the petition, it places the participant name, street address, phone and email in the top-left contact block and refuses Case Number, Judicial District and County, Court Address and the caption Petitioner name, each for want of a drawn rule. Utah writes those blanks as typed underscore leaders in the text layer rather than as rectangles, and the method gives a caption with no rule no coordinate. A cannabis-expungement petition that does not state its case number, its court or the petitioner name is not a filing, so what the method can place is not a packet.
rows.noFillableUtahEditionIsHeld: Zero of the 59 UT entries in the committed corpus index carry an AcroForm, so there is no fillable edition of any of these five to bind instead.

wrongPartyHazardMeasuredNotAsserted.whatWasMeasured: Every anchor the shared derivation keeps was classified against the printed HEADINGS of its own page - located by matching the heading text and then by column x or by distance below it - rather than against its caption string. 15 of the 36 kept anchors across the five documents land inside a block the form says belongs to somebody else.
examples: 1044XX is a two-column cover sheet with Defendant/Respondent governing from x=310. Seven anchors carrying participant.full_legal_name, participant.street_address and participant.phone start at x=320.1, which would name the participant as the opposing party, and two more sit ~26pt below the Attorney or Licensed Paralegal Practitioner headings, which would state the participant is counsel.

1146XX and 1148XX print the participant contact block at the top and the prosecutor block lower down. participant.street_address lands 30.7pt and participant.phone 78.8pt below the printed heading Prosecutor (print name), on an Acceptance of Service.

1003EX gives a 474pt participant.full_legal_name box to the line I am [ ] Plaintiff/Petitioner [ ] Plaintiff/Petitioners Attorney (Utah Bar #:____), which is an election and a bar number, not a name blank.
wrongPartyHazardMeasuredNotAsserted.whyThisIsInTheReturn: It is not the stop and it does not become one, because a curated anchor set fixes it. It is here so the next lane does not run the shared derivation over these five and ship its output.

captionChannelDefectOnTheseBytes.finding: The caption channel misreads these bytes. Kerned runs come back transposed - PlaintiffP/etitioner, Check your email.ou wY, Judicial District C ounty - and the shared captionIsUndecodable test looks only for control characters and replacement glyphs above a 15% share, so transposition passes it.
captionChannelDefectOnTheseBytes.measured: 2 of the 5 anchors the method keeps on the petition were bound off a caption that was never correctly read.
captionChannelDefectOnTheseBytes.status: Reported, not corrected. scripts/generate-rcap-flat-overlay-profiles.mjs and scripts/rcap-official-forms/ are shared and are not this lane to edit. That generator writes overlay-profile.derived.json for review rather than a filed packet, so the exposure is bounded, but the same caption channel is what a build lane would reach for.

whatWouldUnblockIt: binding a fillable Utah edition of 1003EX, 1023EX, 1044XX, 1146XX and 1148XX if the courts publish one, so the case number, court and caption blanks have controls to write into

or a reviewed extension of the flat-overlay method that measures a typed underscore leader in the text layer as a write box - these forms use that device for every blank that matters, and the present method refuses to guess at it by design, which is the correct default and also the thing that blocks this family
and in either case a curated anchor set for this family, because run uncurated the shared derivation places 15 anchors inside a block another party owns
